_comment: Alert-rule family map for the NOVELTY signature (INV-02: loadable/git-reviewed data, never a Go literal). The SAME physical fault surfaces under several source rule names; the novelty gate keys on the rule, so without this a de-novel under one alias never covers the others. Each family lists the source rule strings (case-insensitive, trimmed) that denote the same remediation-warranting condition. Editing this changes ONLY the novelty MATCH — never what actuates, never any other gate.
_comment_native: "Device-Down" is TG's OWN label, minted by modules/ingest/pveliveness for a guest running->stopped edge, and it is listed here DELIBERATELY. It shared this family before only by coincidence: canonicalRule falls back to identity for an unmapped rule, and the identity string happened to equal this family's NAME. Renaming the family would therefore have silently split the liveness intake from the push intake — a de-novel under a LibreNMS alias would stop covering the same fault seen by the poller. core/knowledge/rulefamily_native_test.go asserts the membership against the production constant so the coincidence cannot come back.
